PLAN "Couch-to-5K (12 Weeks) – EIA-Safe Progression"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS

    name "Complete a 5K run safely with EIA management"

        main straight_sets:
          run_walk_intervals 1x20m rpe 5 rest 0 seconds
        cooldown:
          easy_walk 5m
